title: Energy and infrastructure
learning_outcomes: Explain energy forms in the context of energy and infrastructure.
Compare and distinguish infrastructure networks in the context of energy and infrastructure.
Apply cost reliability environment in the context of energy and infrastructure.
Evaluate and justify decisions about resilience in the context of energy and infrastructure.

lessons.title: Energy forms
lessons.outcome: Explain energy forms in the context of energy and infrastructure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving energy forms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to infrastructure systems model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain energy forms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of energy forms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Infrastructure networks
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish infrastructure networks in the context of energy and infrastructure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving infrastructure networks; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to infrastructure systems model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain infrastructure networks from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of infrastructure networks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cost reliability environment
lessons.outcome: Apply cost reliability environment in the context of energy and infrastructure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cost reliability environment; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to infrastructure systems model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cost reliability environment from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cost reliability environment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Resilience
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about resilience in the context of energy and infrastructure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving resilience; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to infrastructure systems model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain resilience from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of resilience; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of energy forms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of infrastructure networks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cost reliability environment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of resilience; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
